residency.identity: complete SHA256 and per-component SHA256 at acquisition; direct fixed local NTFS retains read-only file leases, stable file IDs and latched membership/attribute notifications before reuse and after load. Same exact base/ordered adapter paths reuse detached SHA identities without inventories/new handles; drive mappings and notifications are checked before/after reuse. SUBST/UNC aliases, case-distinct collisions or unsupported protection repeat full bytes. Mapping checks are boundary snapshots, not privileged-remapping protection. Base changes reload adapted transformer/conditioner; byte-identical unadapted Qwen/VAE/tokenizers may be reused after exact class/dtype checks
residency.isolation: fresh pipeline blocks, scheduler, guider and TeaCache controller per job
residency.initialization: First serve request validates input and acquires the identity lease on the owner thread, then overlaps background full-byte hashing with dependency imports on that same owner thread. The reader resumes as soon as imports end, even if hashing continues. Prepared identity/timings pass directly into generation; errors join hashing before lease release and post-load identity verification remains. No ML dependency imports or lease ownership move to the hash thread. Components still load/upload sequentially with bounded staging.
residency.loraStrengthChanges: reuse unchanged base/adapter bytes; update active adapter weights without reloading

textEncodingCache.scope: Qwen embeddings and T5 ids/masks; plain and weighted requests reuse matching raw negative snapshots on pair misses within the same bounded cache. Weighted positive encoding keeps its token overrides; conditioned embeddings and prompt weight application always recomputed
textEncodingCache.invalidation: release/failure or changed encoder/tokenizer bytes; raw text cache may survive base change only when Qwen and both tokenizers are actually reused
textEncodingCache.benchmark: disabled on both sides of TeaCache comparison

residency.cancelErrorTimeout: Cooperative cancellation at stage/step boundaries; cleanup and ready before reuse. Complete jobs also release unused allocator reserves while retaining live weights. Cancellation checks only initialized CUDA; unacknowledged cancellation after 10 seconds, errors and timeouts terminate the owned worker.
residency.realDeviceValidation: 2026-10-11: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, converted MiaoMiao 1.6, real text/image/manual-mask and two Kohya character adapters; bounded sample only
residency.loraGroupChanges: independent base/adapter leases; reject changed adapter-name unions before hotswap tensor loading/conversion, retaining finite strength validation and checked ordinary reload. Matching unions still require the full exact component topology/config preflight after base restoration. Other safe groups unload/load; unknown or base-mutating initialization reloads the base

maskCache.location: CPU only; complete model overlaps Anima residency
maskCache.identity: all local model asset bytes plus clipseg-single-image-vision-v1; exact hashes reused only under continuous local NTFS file/ancestor protection with latched whole-tree membership watches; unsupported paths retain complete byte hashing, and post-load checks use the original protection interval. Vision layers keyed by image mode/size/pixel SHA-256, logits also by ordered stripped phrases including repeats; threshold/growth applied each job
maskCache.invalidation: model bytes change, failure or worker retirement
maskCache.benchmark: disabled on both sides of TeaCache comparison

memoryPolicy.implementation: native_memory.py shares pinned Diffusers ComponentsManager stage ownership with Anima/adapters; offload replans per task from free CUDA bytes minus max(1 GiB, total/4), using synchronous block/leaf groups for over-budget text encoders/denoisers. VAE/vocoder keep component placement and existing tiling because encode/decode can bypass root forward. No prefetch/dtype changes. Tea temporary forwards run inside group onload/post-offload; all Anima weights retire before Remacri
memoryPolicy.fusion: merge transformer and conditioner on CUDA one component at a time, then retire to CPU; do not replace CUDA fusion with CPU arithmetic
memoryPolicy.limits: No CPU inference fallback or quantization; activation budgets are conservative estimates, not shape-specific OOM guarantees. A single leaf and activations must still fit GPU. Offload uses host RAM and transfers; explicit LoRA fusion still needs a whole component on CUDA
memoryPolicy.validation: Budgeted grouping and protected adapter residency require current CUDA acceptance. The 2026-10-13 RTX 4070 Ti SUPER comparison covers the historical component-only implementation, not these changes. No general 4/8GB compatibility claim.

optionalAcceleration.settingsField: inference.acceleration; persisted by the host and forwarded to worker/diagnosis; environment override takes precedence
optionalAcceleration.validatedPlatform: Windows CPython 3.11, Torch 2.8.0+cu128, NVIDIA Ada SM89
optionalAcceleration.nativeAttention: Exact stock Cosmos processor types use the existing bundled processor to skip K/V repeat_interleave copies only when repeats=1; native dispatch, projections, normalization, rotary and non-unit repeats remain. K/V layout changes; source/API and compilation reviewed, no current CUDA timing or image acceptance. Only native Tea scopes require fresh calibration for this change
optionalAcceleration.scope: Cosmos attention only; conditioner and VAE attention retain their original paths. compiled-sage keeps PEFT projections; compiled-fused-sage explicitly merges supported Linear LoRAs into resident weights
optionalAcceleration.fusion: Opt-in compiled-fused-sage: protected base-preserving adapters restore exact safetensors bytes within <=32 MiB active read/conversion buffers. Same-dtype CUDA groups larger than 16 MiB with rows <=16 MiB use two slots <=16 MiB each, overlapping reads with current-stream copies; Events gate reuse and success/failure drains before releasing buffers/host cache. Exact-device grouping; CPU/cast/small/large-row groups remain serial. Independent CPU snapshot fallback remains without a source lease. Safe merge retains packed CUDA storage; restore precedes PEFT mutation, never rounded delta subtraction. Current device performance/restoration evidence unverified
optionalAcceleration.compile: original block.forward, fullgraph=false, mode=default; no CUDA graphs, no VAE compile; first-use/shape/LoRA changes may compile and have extra latency
optionalAcceleration.calibration: execution mode and revision bind the Tea profile; earlier profiles require fresh calibration

dependencies.name: sageattention
dependencies.distribution: Windows maintainer binary, not the upstream authors' official binary

observations.loraLoading: Fresh load/hotswap adapter count and CPU wall interval; successful packed hotswap entries report actual device, strategy/bytes/calls/staging and upload wall. CPU targets and unsupported layouts emit no per-device entry; total LoRA wall includes original PEFT transfers. Not emitted for unchanged adapters
observations.fusionRestore: Fresh restore wall, completed sourceBytes, retained CPU snapshotBytes, <=32 MiB bufferPeakBytes and source-only copyCalls/pipelinedGroups/serialGroups. Counters exclude snapshot copies; not reused across jobs. Intervals overlap modelAcquire and must not be summed
observations.timing: CPU wall intervals with no additional GPU synchronization; existing TeaCache report synchronization is explicitly marked
observations.boundaries: workerWall includes validation/imports through PNG save; pipelineWall includes encoding, denoising and decoding; outputSave includes compression and atomic write; composite is CPU pixel compositing
observations.notAdditive: workerWall includes the other intervals; residentFingerprint includes initial identity and post-load verification that can overlap modelAcquire; do not sum these fields
observations.completedSteps: observed scheduler.step calls, not requested inference steps or proof of Comfy schedule equivalence
observations.memory: per-job PyTorch native allocator peaks on initialized CUDA device 0, reset before image preparation and read after pipeline; includes retained allocations/reservations, excludes non-PyTorch/device-wide memory
observations.memoryUnverified: ordinary product jobs with cold uninitialized CUDA, non-native allocator, unavailable/invalid counters; existing explicit TeaCache/measure/collect reports retain one reset attempt, with failure unverified; never initialize CUDA or read historical peaks for observation
observations.cacheScope: baseReused describes the base only; text hit/miss counters are per job, entries/CPU bytes are resident; automatic mask stats appear only when used in this job
observations.validation: 2026-10-11 real CUDA jobs record stage timings and allocator peaks; whole-device memory parity and measurement-overhead isolation remain unverified; see native-backend-performance.html
observations.initialization: dependencySetupWallSeconds records first serve initialization separately; workerWallSeconds includes it. Required CUDA initialization precedes per-job allocator reset, including the first job. Current allocated/reserved values refer to pipeline completion before final per-job reserve cleanup.

capabilities.scheduleMeaning: Euler/simple and RES/simple sample the 1000-entry training grid; normal/sgm_uniform use explicit Anima shift-3 grids. Img2img and hires take N updates from the tail of a full int(N/denoise) schedule. CPU FP32 job generators replace CUDA generators in both passes. Independent deterministic RES uses FP32 history, eta=0, no CFG++
capabilities.rcas: independent FP32 workflow cross filter: reflect, five-point extrema, RGB minimum lobe, epsilon 1e-6, strength before lobe limiting and reciprocal normalization; 128-row scratch with real interior halo and reflected image borders, full input/output retained; functional specification matches fixed KJ d3cfe216 rcas; current device output/latency/peak memory unverified
capabilities.rgbCompositing: PIL-to-FP32 normalization borrows already-RGB input and divides its private NumPy array in place; masked composite overwrites only the private reference and new result, preserving separate multiply/subtract/multiply/add and existing Lanczos/uint8 boundaries
capabilities.hiresFix: Latent bicubic plus a fresh tail-schedule pass, or fixed FP32 Remacri 4x then target resize; masked paths preserve the resized reference outside the effective mask
capabilities.vae: single-frame exact Qwen modules with no temporal feature cache; eligible CausalConv uses last time slice and implicit spatial padding; RMS normalizes in original dtype; FP32 latent statistics, raw-latent bicubic and display boundaries; whole frame first, CUDA OOM only encode256/64 or budgeted decode tile with quarter overlap, CPU FP32 feather; no precision/device fallback
capabilities.remacriTiling: 512 input pixels/32 overlap, CPU FP32 symmetric-ramp numerator/divisor, clamp after normalization; shared VAE/Remacri assembly keeps full-tile ramps and separate multiply/add with 128 output rows of weight/product scratch. Final CPU image finiteness checks use 128-row scratch, including the outer VAE boundary. Real CUDA OOM retries entire 256 then128; only each source tile transfers to model execution device
capabilities.remacriLoading: Complete key/shape/F32/finite checks precede existing packed CUDA upload with at most 64 MiB active pinned staging; unsupported layouts retain module.to and CUDA failures propagate. One CPU weight set is cached within 128 MiB, keyed by complete SHA256 and file identity; exact hashes reused only under continuous local NTFS file/ancestor protection, with the original interval checked after load/pass. Unsupported paths retain complete before/after byte hashing; profile SHA equality remains required. CUDA modules remain pass-local. Changed bytes, cancellation, failure and resident retirement clear the cache and protection. refinement.upscale records execution revision, loading cacheHit, fingerprint/read/upload CPU wall and actual upload counters. Current cache performance and image effects need device acceptance
capabilities.imageQuantization: Lanczos and final PNG convert display RGB with FP32 multiply, clip and uint8 truncation using 128-row scratch instead of full-size float temporaries; release private CPU FP32 transfer storage before Pillow output allocation and the temporary 4x float canvas after its independent RGB8 conversion. Final unmasked Remacri without second sampling or RCAS retains RGB8-to-FP32 /255 then *255/clip/truncation in 128-row bands instead of a full float canvas; soft masks never quantized
capabilities.hiresTeaCache: Built-in Anima policy on both denoising passes; clear residuals between passes and before VAE; no per-resolution calibration. Explicit maintenance profiles retain exact scope validation.
capabilities.weightSyntax: Anima round-bracket and explicit nested weights; Qwen fragments unweighted, T5 conditioner output weighted once. Square brackets and BREAK remain literal. Both tokenizer streams are bounded to 512 tokens with explicit rejection before truncation
capabilities.loraFormat: Native Diffusers or officially mapped diffusion_model-prefixed Anima A/B; strict original-Anima lora_unet linear down/up/alpha triples with exact loaded-target shapes and alpha/rank scaling. Other Kohya variants and DoRA unsupported
capabilities.loraHotswapUpload: Only after complete group preflight: each adapter uses existing packed upload by actual CUDA target device, then original Diffusers/PEFT swap/compiled copy and loaded-key checks; CPU and unsupported layouts retain upstream tensor.to. Release consumed states/aliases before next adapter. At most 64 MiB active pinned staging, but temporary GPU storage may increase by one adapter plus alignment. Initial LoRA metadata/initializer/dtype path and Tea identity unchanged; device speed/memory/output unverified
capabilities.maskGrowth: manual equivalent RGB red-channel contain/pad (straight RGBA red-only takes R directly; other modes preserve RGB conversion), in-place /255 of private FP32 pixels, ordered five-neighbour max writes into the independent FP32 resized output from per-round edge padding without a five-image stack; same tapered diamond and manual v3 identity. Automatic masks separately use square dilation then float feather; current allocation benefits are source-derived, with syntax/source review only; device timing and peak memory remain unverified

automaticMask.postprocessSource: AP ClipSEG Light af83f91335822be272b23e29040e34d82622601c, MIT; retained MASK_PROCESSING_LICENSE.txt; local loading remains native, no upstream automatic download or TensorFlow stub
automaticMask.visionEncoding: one CPU FP32 query image per job; selected hidden_states[extract_layer+1] reused through read-only batch expand for each decoder batch. Same image may reuse one <=16MiB owned selected-layer snapshot across prompt edits
automaticMask.postprocess: ordered mean phrase logits with repeats; Torch bilinear; 3x 5x5 reflect box smooth; sigmoid threshold to FP32 0/1, releasing resized logits before growth; exact binary square growth by bounded integer row/column prefix presence with clipped coordinates, reusing private FP32 threshold storage with the same canonical layout; 3x 25x25 reflect box feather; float masks preserved through latent trilinear and hires nearest-exact/composite
automaticMask.weightLicense: separate review required; original model card not accessible during implementation review

teaCache.defaultPolicy: Built-in Anima policy, threshold 0.10; false or threshold 0 disables. Ordinary generation never reads existing profile files.
teaCache.profileCollection: Maintenance only: explicit teaCacheProfilePath or internal candidate API; exact runtime and compatibility validation required.
teaCache.candidateMeaning: phase-specific observed error envelopes; refresh on phase transition; not a semantic quality bound

localGuardCandidate.decision: both global mean and worst contiguous-token-group empirical phase budgets must permit reuse; no semantic/error guarantee
localGuardCandidate.selection: maintenance --strategy local-guard; product read_profile excludes schema3 even if stored/accepted, preserving existing production choices
localGuardCandidate.calibration: requires exact collector and paired global/local proxy/residual traces; explicit future CUDA --run; candidate file has no automatic acceptance
localGuardCandidate.status: source and compilation only; no real calibration, output or performance evidence

teaCache.requires: Bundled worker and supported Anima model; no calibration file
teaCache.threshold: Built-in: 0..1, default 0.10. Explicit local profiles: profile default and 0.01..maxThreshold.
teaCache.isolation: one-job controller, separate CFG lanes, exact conditioning snapshots
teaCache.realDeviceValidation: 2026-10-13 authorized RTX 4070 Ti SUPER product-API acceptance: MiaoMiao 1.6 / Nene 0.8, ordinary/Latent/Remacri generation, cancellation/recovery, resident/offload and idle release. Warm median native 5.05s vs Comfy+Tea 5.54s (three samples). Overall images close with local hires finger differences. Not every model/prompt/device.

licenseScope: Direct Python dependency license identifiers only, not a bundled distribution SBOM. Retain upstream package notices and review transitive/CUDA runtime licenses before redistribution. No model weights are bundled or downloaded. Each model and LoRA has separate license terms; this manifest grants no rights to them.

validation.currentRevision: 2026-10-13: builtin Anima cache, first-request initialization gate, cooperative cancellation and per-job reserve release exercised on local CUDA; final desktop installed and user accepted. Current capability and device limits: docs/project-status.md.
validation.realGeneration: 2026-10-11: six registered Anima models generated 11 GPU samples, plus one Endfield/Laevatain public-API sample. Nene/Natsume normal/RCAS LoRA+Tea: 12 matched warm API jobs per backend on RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, native median 4.419s vs Comfy+Tea 5.686s, all 12 pairs faster. Latent 2x Nene: two warm API jobs per backend, native 26.610s vs Comfy 23.671s; cold loading also remains slower. Protected-source restore removed 3.28 GiB CPU snapshots and preserved four diagnostic PNG hashes. Not mathematical or pixel parity.
validation.environmentInstall: 2026-10-11: all 11 exact direct pins resolved, installed offline in dedicated Windows CPython 3.11 venv, and imports/CUDA diagnosis passed; torch and torchvision use cu128 wheels. No inference-time installation or ComfyUI environment reuse
validation.validateScope: Checks layout, safetensors shard presence, exact installed dependency versions and imports. Does not load weights, verify model semantics, test GPU memory, or generate.
validation.diagnoseScope: Checks bundled manual/CLIPSeg helpers, exact dependency versions/imports including PIL image processor and CLIP tokenizer, CUDA availability and device name; no model required, no tensors allocated, no weights loaded, no generation.
